notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
Twilight Shepherd does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd, adding {C}{C}.
Twilight Shepherd dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Twilight Shepherd enters the battlefield, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Twilight Shepherd and Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Twilight Shepherd trigger, returning to your hand all cards that were put into your graveyard this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R/W}{W}{W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Twilight Shepherd by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Twilight Shepherd enters the battlefield, returning to your hand all cards that were put into your graveyard this turn.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
